meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 它带你按 6 步把已有的 AKS 集群从裸集群走到跑起模型:检查集群、装 AI Runway 控制器、评估 GPU、配置推理后端、部署首个模型并汇总。每一步先报告状态(✓健康/✗缺失),动手安装或部署前先征求你确认。
howto.when: 当你提到 AI Runway setup、把模型部署到 AKS、在 AKS 上跑 GPU 推理等需求时触发。前提是已有 AKS 集群;没有集群会先转给 azure-kubernetes 去创建,再回到本流程。

howto.what_en: It walks you through 6 steps on an existing AKS cluster: verify cluster, install the AI Runway controller, assess GPU, set up an inference provider, deploy a first model, and summarize. It asks before installing or deploying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention AI Runway setup, deploy a model to AKS, or GPU inference on AKS. It assumes an AKS cluster already exists; otherwise hand off to azure-kubernetes first.
